subject: MAP: Re-sequence close milestones — proposed phased cutover + risk register
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@neptuneanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Re-sequence close milestones — proposed phased cutover + risk register

Sara — thanks again for the sync this morning. After internal alignment with product and CS I want to propose a concrete re-sequence of the MAP to keep momentum while procurement completes the SOW review.

High level ask: agree to a phased cutover so Neptune can start limited evaluation access (canary environment + 100k tokens/day) ahead of full contract signature. This reduces your evaluation risk and preserves the original go/no-go E2E timeline for the team while procurement finishes paperwork.

What I'm attaching:
- neptune_map_v2.xlsx (MAP with new milestones + owners)
- redwood_risk_register_20260918.csv (concise risk items and mitigations)
- SOW_draft_neptune.pdf (for procurement review)

Proposed phased milestones (short):
1) Evaluation canary kickoff — 2026-10-05: API keys, sample dataset onboarding, daily sync cadence
2) Expanded eval window — 2026-10-19: increased throughput, longer prompt sets, joint evals
3) Production enablement (post-SOW signature) — target 2026-11-16 (fallback: 2026-12-01)

Key risks and mitigations (summary):
- Procurement lag (Procurement requests SOC2 + SOW redlines): mitigation = phased access + shared SOC2 summary + expedited SOW review via DocuSign
- Integration regressions found during expanded eval: mitigation = reserved engineering canary support hours + rollback plan in MAP
- Cost/discovery mismatch: mitigation = temporary usage cap and billing hold until sign-off

Next steps: can you confirm by EOD today whether Neptune can accept the canary access (item 1) and whether procurement requires any additional artifacts beyond the SOW and SOC2 summary? If yes, please loop procurement contact and a target sign date.

Thanks — I marked action owners in the MAP. If it helps I can schedule a 30-minute procurement-only call tomorrow.

—Marcus

Hi Marcus — thanks for the plan and the quick turnaround. We can accept a limited canary, but procurement needs a final SOW and SOC2 evidence to approve production spend. They asked me to confirm two items:

1) The SOC2 summary link / evidence (we need the report or an authorized attestation; the SOC2 summary link you provided should help but procurement may request the full report through an NDA).
2) Confirmation that canary access will be rate-limited and will not incur production billing until SOW is signed (we need this in writing).

I looped procurement on this thread. Procurement lead is following up separately (procurement@neptuneanalytics.com). Once we get the SOW + SOC2 pointer and a written canary safety confirmation, procurement will try to fast-track.

—Sara
Sara Thompson

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

On Fri, Sep 18, 2026 at 11:03 AM Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@neptuneanalytics.com> wrote:
> Hi Marcus — thanks for the plan and the quick turnaround. We can accept a limited canary...

Quick internal take: agree with phased access. To keep deal economics and unblock procurement, recommend we offer:
- A written canary safety bullet (no production billing, usage cap 100k tokens/day, automatic throttling)
- A one-time evaluation extension (2 weeks) if procurement extends approval beyond the production target
- Up to 6 hours of priority canary engineering support (to move regressions faster)

Monica: can you draft the canary safety confirmation and the short support SOW? Laura: check whether we can attach a provisional PO acceptance clause to the SOW to reassure procurement.

I'll standby for Marcus to send the formal confirmation and to propose a target date for canary kickoff. We should also prepare a concise exec note if procurement stalls — I can draft a 1-paragraph escalation to our CRO.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@neptuneanalytics.com>, Procurement <procurement@neptuneanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Re-sequence close milestones — proposed phased cutover + risk register

Sara / Procurement team — following up with the formal confirmations Ben outlined. Please see the short responses below and attached artifacts.

1) SOC2 evidence: we can share our SOC2 summary immediately (https://redwood.app/docs/soc2-summary). If procurement requires the full report, we will provide it under an NDA; Laura has the NDA template ready.

2) Canary safety confirmation (formal):
- Canary environment will be explicitly flagged as evaluation access; Redwood will not charge for tokens beyond a nominal engineering support credit until the SOW is signed.
- Usage cap: 100,000 tokens/day across Neptune org, with automatic throttling at cap.
- Billing hold: no production billing will be applied; any usage above capped threshold will be paused and reviewed with Neptune.

3) SOW: attached SOW_draft_neptune.pdf — this is the working draft. We also created a provisional clause allowing Neptune to accept a PO contingent on final SOW redlines to speed procurement. Link to DocuSign: https://docusign.com/s/ABC123-SOW

Proposed re-baseline (MAP excerpt):
- Canary kickoff: 2026-10-05 (owner: Neptune + Redwood eng)
- Expanded eval: 2026-10-19 (owner: Neptune product + Redwood CS)
- Target sign date: 2026-11-02 (procurement milestone)
- Production enablement: 2026-11-16 (fallback 2026-12-01)

If procurement can confirm a target sign date this week we will lock the production enablement milestone earlier. Otherwise we will keep the fallback and proceed with the canary as planned.

Action items (owners):
- Procurement (Neptune): confirm whether full SOC2 report required + provide procurement contact name (procurement@neptuneanalytics.com noted) — (Due: 2026-09-22)
- Laura Bennett (Redwood): prepare NDA & expedited SOW DocuSign (Due: 2026-09-21)
- Monica Patel (Redwood): schedule canary kickoff and book 6 hours of priority support (Due: 2026-09-30)

Thanks — will join any procurement call if helpful.

—Marcus
